items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mouse Randolph was a player that was a little before my time. ... They tell me he was a very reputable soloist

ctx.x: Mouse Randolph was a player that was a little before my time. He ended up playing in Earl Hines – one of Earl Hines’s very first bands. They tell me he was a very reputable soloist, a very great section player and lead player.
